prompts.L1:
Please polish the following text to make it more eloquent and professional, keeping all original information unchanged:

According to one example of the present invention, provided is a method for allowing an advertisement-providing server connected to a user terminal to provide an advertisement through an advertisement-providing application installed on the user terminal, the method comprising the steps of: (a) receiving, from the user terminal, an activation-requesting signal for making a request to change the state of a display part of the user terminal from being off to being on; (b) providing the advertisement to the display part according to the activation-requesting signal; (c) receiving, from the user terminal to which the advertisement is provided, an advertisement content-requesting signal for making a request to provide advertisement content associated with the advertisement; (d) if receiving the advertisement content-requesting signal, providing the advertisement content to the user terminal; and (e) accumulating, for the user terminal, a first reward according to the activation-requesting signal and a second reward according to the advertisement content-requesting signal.

prompts.L5:
Please write a text about the following topic:

Keywords: According

outputs.L1: According to one embodiment of the present invention, a method is provided for enabling an advertisement-providing server connected to a user terminal to deliver an advertisement through an advertisement-providing application installed on the user terminal, the method comprising the steps of: (a) receiving, from the user terminal, an activation-requesting signal requesting a change in the state of a display part of the user terminal from off to on; (b) providing the advertisement to the display part in response to the activation-requesting signal; (c) receiving, from the user terminal to which the advertisement has been provided, an advertisement content-requesting signal requesting provision of advertisement content associated with the advertisement; (d) upon receiving the advertisement content-requesting signal, providing the advertisement content to the user terminal; and (e) accumulating, for the user terminal, a first reward corresponding to the activation-requesting signal and a second reward corresponding to the advertisement content-requesting signal.
outputs.L2: In one embodiment of the invention, a method is provided in which an advertisement delivery server, connected to a user terminal, supplies an advertisement via an advertisement delivery application installed on that terminal. The method includes: (a) receiving, from the user terminal, an activation request signal that requests switching a display portion of the user terminal from an off state to an on state; (b) delivering the advertisement to the display portion in response to the activation request signal; (c) receiving, from the user terminal that has received the advertisement, an advertisement content request signal seeking provision of advertisement content linked to the advertisement; (d) when the advertisement content request signal is received, sending the advertisement content to the user terminal; and (e) crediting the user terminal with a first reward based on the activation request signal and a second reward based on the advertisement content request signal.
outputs.L3:
The method enables an advertisement-providing server to deliver advertisements through an application installed on a user terminal, such as a smartphone, tablet, or other mobile device.

When the user terminal requests activation of its display, for example by changing the display state from off to on, the advertisement-providing server receives an activation-requesting signal from the user terminal. In response to receiving this activation-requesting signal, the server provides an advertisement to be displayed on the user terminal’s display.

If the user interacts with the advertisement or otherwise requests additional advertisement-related information, the user terminal transmits an advertisement content-requesting signal to the advertisement-providing server. Upon receiving the advertisement content-requesting signal, the server provides associated advertisement content to the user terminal. This associated content may include, for example, detailed product information, promotional material, a landing page, a coupon, or other content related to the displayed advertisement.

The server also manages rewards associated with these events. Specifically, the server accumulates a first reward in response to receiving the activation-requesting signal, and accumulates a second reward in response to receiving the advertisement content-requesting signal. In this way, rewards may be granted based both on activation of the terminal display and on a subsequent request for advertisement-related content.
outputs.L4:
A method and system are provided for delivering advertisements to a user terminal through an application installed on the terminal and for rewarding the user based on advertisement exposure and interaction. The method may be performed by an advertisement-providing server that communicates with the user terminal over a network. When the display of the user terminal is activated, for example when the user turns on the screen, unlocks the terminal, or otherwise causes the display to enter an active state, the application may request an advertisement from the advertisement-providing server. In response, the server transmits advertisement data to the application, and the application displays the advertisement on the terminal.

The advertisement may be displayed in various forms, such as a banner, image, video, text message, interactive content, or a screen displayed before or after the terminal is unlocked. The advertisement may include summary information, a selectable object, or a link that allows the user to request additional information or related advertisement content. If the user selects the advertisement or otherwise requests the related content, the application transmits a request to the advertisement-providing server. The server then provides the requested ad-related content to the user terminal, such as a detailed advertisement page, promotional information, a coupon, a purchase page, a brand page, a video, or other content associated with the advertisement.

The system also provides a reward mechanism for encouraging user engagement with advertisements. The advertisement-providing server may accumulate a reward for the user when an advertisement is displayed in response to activation of the terminal display. In addition, the server may accumulate a further reward when the user requests or accesses the related advertisement content. The reward may be provided in the form of points, credits, mileage, coupons, cash-equivalent benefits, virtual currency, discounts, or other incentives. The amount of the reward may vary depending on factors such as the type of advertisement, the number of display activations, the number of ad content requests, the user’s interaction history, or conditions set by an advertiser.

Accordingly, the method enables advertisements to be delivered at a time when the user’s attention is likely to be directed to the terminal, such as when the display is activated. By additionally providing related advertisement content upon the user’s request and granting rewards based on both advertisement exposure and user interaction, the system encourages users to view and engage with advertisements while providing advertisers with increased opportunities to deliver promotional content effectively.
outputs.L5:
According to many sources, the word “according” is often used to introduce information, opinions, rules, or facts that come from another person, document, or authority. It helps connect a statement to its source and makes writing more clear and credible.

For example, when someone says, “According to the report, sales increased this year,” they are showing that the information comes from a specific report. This word is commonly used in academic writing, journalism, business communication, and everyday conversation.

Using “according” correctly can make a text sound more professional. It is usually followed by “to,” as in “according to experts,” “according to the law,” or “according to recent studies.” However, it should not be used to refer to your own opinion. Instead of saying “according to me,” it is better to say “in my opinion” or “I believe.”

Overall, “according” is a useful word for presenting information clearly and showing where that information comes from.

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a formal “according to one example of the present invention” description for an advertisement-providing server connected to a user terminal, including activation signals, ad display, content requests, and reward accumulation.
counterfactuals.output:
According to one example of the present invention, an advertisement-providing server is connected to a user terminal through a communication network and is configured to provide an advertisement to the user terminal in association with use of content by a user.

The advertisement-providing server may include a communication unit configured to transmit and receive data to and from the user terminal, a storage unit configured to store advertisement information, content information, user identification information, and reward information, and a controller configured to control an advertisement-providing operation and a reward-accumulating operation.

In one example, the controller receives, from the user terminal, an activation signal indicating that a predetermined application, program, service, or content-use environment has been activated at the user terminal. In response to receiving the activation signal, the controller selects at least one advertisement from the advertisement information stored in the storage unit and transmits advertisement display information corresponding to the selected advertisement to the user terminal. The user terminal may then display the advertisement on a display screen thereof.

The advertisement may be displayed before, during, or after execution of content, or may be displayed on a portion of a screen while the user accesses the content. The advertisement display information may include at least one of image data, video data, text data, audio data, link information, display time information, or interaction information for the advertisement.

The controller may receive, from the user terminal, advertisement display confirmation information indicating that the advertisement has been displayed on the user terminal. The advertisement display confirmation information may include at least one of a display start time, a display completion time, a display duration, user interaction information, or terminal identification information.

In addition, the controller receives, from the user terminal, a content request signal requesting provision of predetermined content. The content request signal may be generated before or after display of the advertisement, and may include at least one of user identification information, content identification information, terminal information, access time information, or authentication information.

When the content request signal is received, the controller determines whether a reward accumulation condition has been satisfied based on the activation signal, the advertisement display confirmation information, and/or the content request signal. The reward accumulation condition may include, for example, whether the advertisement has been displayed for a predetermined period of time, whether the user has selected or interacted with the advertisement, whether the content request has been normally completed, or whether the user terminal is associated with a valid user account.

When it is determined that the reward accumulation condition has been satisfied, the controller accumulates a reward corresponding to the user identification information. The reward may include at least one of points, mileage, credits, coupons, virtual currency, discount benefits, access rights, or other compensation usable by the user. The accumulated reward information may be stored in the storage unit in association with the user identification information and may be transmitted to the user terminal so that the user terminal displays a reward accumulation result.

Accordingly, in the advertisement-providing server according to one example of the present invention, an advertisement is provided to a user terminal in response to an activation signal, a content request from the user terminal is processed in association with the advertisement display, and a reward is accumulated for the user when a predetermined condition is satisfied, thereby enabling advertisement exposure and user compensation to be performed in connection with content use.

일 실시예에 따르면, 광고 제공 시스템은 사용자 단말에 설치된 모바일 애플리케이션으로부터 화면 활성화 요청을 수신하는 단계, 상기 화면 활성화 요청에 응답하여 상기 사용자 단말 또는 상기 모바일 애플리케이션의 식별정보를 확인하는 단계, 상기 식별정보에 기초하여 광고 노출 가능 여부를 판단하는 단계, 및 상기 광고 노출 가능 여부의 판단 결과에 따라 상기 모바일 애플리케이션의 활성화 화면에 표시될 광고 정보를 제공하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

상기 화면 활성화 요청은, 예를 들어, 상기 사용자 단말의 잠금 화면 해제, 상기 모바일 애플리케이션의 실행, 백그라운드 상태로부터 포그라운드 상태로의 전환, 또는 특정 메뉴 화면의 호출 중 적어도 하나에 대응하여 생성될 수 있다. 상기 광고 제공 시스템은 상기 화면 활성화 요청에 포함된 단말 식별자, 애플리케이션 식별자, 사용자 식별자, 위치 정보, 시간 정보, 네트워크 상태 정보 및 광고 수신 동의 정보 중 적어도 하나를 이용하여 광고 제공 조건을 결정할 수 있다.

또한, 상기 광고 제공 시스템은 상기 광고 제공 조건이 충족되는 경우, 미리 저장된 광고 콘텐츠 또는 외부 광고 서버로부터 수신된 광고 콘텐츠를 선택하고, 상기 선택된 광고 콘텐츠에 대응하는 광고 메타데이터를 상기 모바일 애플리케이션으로 전송할 수 있다. 상기 광고 메타데이터는 광고 이미지, 동영상, 랜딩 URL, 노출 시간, 클릭 추적 정보, 과금 정보 및 표시 위치 정보 중 적어도 하나를 포함할 수 있다.

한편, 상기 광고 제공 조건이 충족되지 않거나, 네트워크 상태가 불량하거나, 사용자 설정에 따라 광고 수신이 제한된 경우, 상기 광고 제공 시스템은 광고 콘텐츠를 전송하지 않거나, 기본 화면 정보 또는 비광고 콘텐츠를 상기 모바일 애플리케이션으로 제공할 수 있다. 이에 따라, 상기 모바일 애플리케이션은 화면 활성화 요청에 대응하여 광고 콘텐츠를 선택적으로 표시할 수 있으며, 광고 콘텐츠가 제공되지 않은 경우에는 일반 활성화 화면을 표시할 수 있다.
